selector.rationale: Bilateral optic disc edema and transient visual obscurations are consistent with increased intracranial pressure, and the absence of other explanatory findings supports Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension as the most specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Arachnoid Cyst
rejected.why: While the MRI shows cysts, the clinical presentation is more consistent with increased intracranial pressure than a mass effect from a cyst.

rejected.label: Multiple Sclerosis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of demyelinating lesions or other typical features of Multiple Sclerosis in the provided information.
